name: Dimitry Elias Leger on Death of the Soccer God with Francesca Momplaisir
why: Author Dimitry Elias Leger discusses his novel Death of the Soccer God with multilingual scholar Francesca Momplaisir; the book charts a global soccer star's ride to the 1950 World Cup.

name: Summer at the Library: Face Painting with Elaine Messi
venue: Carroll Gardens Pop-up Library (250 Baltic Street)
why: Free face painting with Elaine Messi at the Carroll Gardens Pop-up Library; open to all ages with a selection of designs to choose from.

name: Building Access: The History and Future of Disability Rights
why: A panel on the history and ongoing efforts to bring equal access to schools, workplaces, transit and public spaces, led by CBH Chief Historian Dominique Jean-Louis with disability rights leaders.

name: Recipe Sharing
why: A gathering to share recipes and culinary interests along with favorite cookbooks and books about food.

name: A.M. Gittlitz Discusses Metropolitans: New York Baseball, Class Struggle, and the People's Team
why: Local author A.M. Gittlitz discusses Metropolitans, a history of the New York Mets that examines baseball as a site of political struggle and class consciousness.
